definitions.explanation: A casual first-person pronoun used mainly by males.

examples.japanese: {俺|おれ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{俺|おれ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任|まか}せろ→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧。
{俺|おれ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{野球|やきゅう}→野球：04727_yakyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}きだった→好き：02355_suki⟧。
examples.english: I've liked baseball ever since I was a kid.

examples.japanese: {俺|おれ}⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: We've been friends since high school, and we've been hanging out together for ten years already.

notes:
{俺|おれ} is a casual, masculine first-person pronoun. It conveys informality and directness.

REGISTER:
- Used among friends, family, and in casual situations
- Can sound rough, assertive, or confident depending on tone
- Not appropriate in formal settings, business, or with superiors
- Some women use it in very casual contexts, but it is primarily masculine

COMMON FORMS:
- {俺|おれ}⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧: we (casual, masculine)
- {俺|おれ}⟦ら→ら：noentry⟧: we (more rough/casual)
- {俺|おれ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: my (casual)

COMPARISON OF FIRST-PERSON PRONOUNS:
- ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧: neutral, polite, used by all genders
- ⟦{僕|ぼく}→僕：01729_boku⟧: masculine, softer and more modest than {俺|おれ}
- {俺|おれ}: masculine, casual, assertive
- ⟦あたし→あたし：noentry⟧: feminine, casual

cross_references.label: neutral, polite, used by all genders
